transcript.text: I'd be happy to start. I remember Aunt Rosa at every holiday dinner — she'd always have these little stories behind the most ordinary things. One year she pulled out a stamp from her purse and told us it was from a letter her father sent home from abroad. She talked about that one stamp for twenty minutes, and none of us minded a bit. She had this way of making small things feel important.
